title: 第5章 老祖秘藏，庚金剑胚
slug: 苟道剑尊从反夺舍老祖开始长生
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

林渊沉默地走上前，蹲下身，看着这具骷髅。

三年前，林家旁系最耀眼的天才，炼气八层修为，一手木系法术使得出神入化，与当年的林渊并称为旁支出类拔萃的双璧。

可三年前的某一天，林远突然在后山离奇失踪，家族寻了三个月未果，最后只得定性为遭遇流窜劫修，不幸身殒。

当时林渊还曾暗自警惕了许久。

可现在，看着这具躺在老祖秘密巢穴里的枯骨，真相早已不言自明。

“原来，你当年不是死于劫修之手……”

林渊伸出手指，轻轻触碰了一下林远那已经干瘪的头盖骨，脑海中属于老祖的记忆碎片再次翻涌。

当年，林老祖已然到了大限将至的关头，急需夺舍。

他盯上了气血方刚、修为达到炼气八层的林远。

可直到将林远制服、强行搜魂夺舍时，老祖才惊恐地发现，林远明面上是双灵根，实则体内隐藏着两条极隐蔽的杂灵根，属于隐性的伪灵根。

伪灵根肉身，神魂契合度极低。

那一场夺舍，老祖虽然凭借强大的神魂底蕴强行压制了林远的反抗，但因为肉身排斥，导致林远的神魂与肉身在法阵中同归于尽，化作了一具死不瞑目的枯骨。

老祖自己也因此神魂大伤，不得不龟缩苦修了三年，直到盯上了拥有纯净金灵根的林渊。

“修仙界弱肉强食，旁系天才，在掌权者眼里，不过是续命的资粮和盛放神魂的容器罢了。”

林渊低语一声，自嘲地笑了笑。

如果不是自己提前三年布局，花光了积蓄买下锁魂玉和灭魂符，如今躺在这暗无天日地下的白骨，怕是要多出自己这一具了。

他叹了口气，从储物袋中取出一块普通的白布，将林远的枯骨一根根小心地拾掇起来，包好。

随后，林渊在密室坚硬的石壁上以灵力抠出一个深坑，将包裹放入其中，最后用掌力将碎石抹平，在上面刻下了五个字：

‘林远道友之墓’。

没有留立碑人的名字。

“道友，尘归尘，土归土。那老东西已经被我打得神魂俱灭，也算替你报了仇。安心去吧。”

林渊对着石壁微微拱手。

这或许是他在这冰冷残酷的修仙界中，极少数流露人性光辉的一瞬。

这一拜，不仅是祭奠昔日的同族道友，更是为了坚定自己的道心——此界无情，视众生为刍狗，但他林渊，要守住自己的底线。

而想要守住底线的前提，是必须活下去，比所有人都活得久。

收敛好枯骨后，林渊转身走向密室中央的石台。

石台上凌乱地摆放着几本册子和一些瓶瓶罐罐。

林渊的目光直接锁定在其中一本用黑色妖兽皮鞣制而成的笔记上。

《夺舍心得要略》。

这是林老祖百年来，历经数次夺舍，其中包括百年前夺舍原主林玄鹤，所记录下来的心血结晶。

上面不仅详细记录了如何计算神魂契合度、如何布置夺舍法阵，更有老祖用无数鲜血换来的珍贵记录——

《神魂吞噬后的后遗症处理方法》。

林渊随手翻开，一页页泛黄的纸张上字迹潦草而疯狂：

“……凡夺舍或强纳他人神魂者，虽能以秘术强行炼化，然识海必存异种神魂之怨念碎片。此碎片如附骨之疽，平日不显，唯在破境筑基、天劫临头之心魔劫中悍然爆发，极易导致功败垂成、爆体而亡……欲除此患，需以秘药养魂汤洗涤识海三载，或在突破时，以至刚至阳之气强行斩灭……”

看到这里，林渊眼神猛地一亮。

这本笔记，原本是老祖准备在夺舍林渊成功后，用来给自己做术后恢复的参考手册。

可如今天道轮回，老祖怎么也想不到，这本笔记竟然成了林渊接下来的筑基参考指南。

Lin Yuan walked forward silently, squatted down, and looked at the skeleton.

Three years ago, the most dazzling genius of the Lin family, who was at the eighth level of qi refining and mastered wood spells, was known as one of the most outstanding twins in the side branch along with Lin Yuan back then.

But one day three years ago, Lin Yuan suddenly disappeared mysteriously in the back mountain. The family searched for him for three months without success. In the end, they had to attribute his death to a wandering cultivator.

At that time, Lin Yuan had been secretly vigilant for a long time.

But now, looking at this withered skeleton lying in the ancestor's secret lair, the truth has long been self-evident.

"It turns out that you didn't die at the hands of Jie Xiu back then..."

Lin Yuan stretched out his fingers and lightly touched Lin Yuan's shriveled skull, and the memory fragments belonging to his ancestors surged again in his mind.

At that time, Patriarch Lin had reached the critical moment when his end was approaching and he urgently needed to seize his body.

He focused on Lin Yuan, who had strong Qi and blood and had reached the eighth level of Qi refining.

But it was not until he subdued Lin Yuan and forcibly searched for his soul that the ancestor was horrified to discover that Lin Yuan appeared to have two spiritual roots, but in fact, he had two extremely hidden mixed spiritual roots hidden in his body, which were hidden pseudo-spiritual roots.

The physical body with false spiritual roots has extremely low compatibility between the soul and the soul.

In that battle, although the ancestor used his powerful soul to suppress Lin Yuan's resistance, due to the rejection of his body, Lin Yuan's soul and body died together in the magic circle, turning into a dead skeleton.

The ancestor himself was seriously injured because of this, and had to retreat and practice hard for three years, until he set his sights on Lin Yuan, who had pure golden spiritual roots.

"In the world of immortality, the weak and the strong prey on the weak. In the eyes of those in power, the geniuses are nothing more than food to extend their lives and containers to hold their souls."

Lin Yuan whispered and smiled to himself.

If he hadn't made plans three years in advance and spent all his savings to buy the soul-locking jade and the soul-destroying talisman, the bones lying here in the dark underground would probably be more than his own.

He sighed, took out a piece of ordinary white cloth from the storage bag, carefully picked up Lin Yuan's bones one by one, and wrapped them up.

Later, Lin Yuan used his spiritual power to dig out a deep pit on the hard stone wall of the secret room, put the package into it, and finally smoothed the gravel with his palms, and carved five words on it:

‘The Tomb of Taoist Fellow Lin Yuan’.

There is no name of the person who built the monument.

"Fellow Taoist, dust will return to dust, dust will return to dust. The old guy has been beaten to death by me, so I have avenged you. Go in peace."

Lin Yuan slightly arched his hands towards the stone wall.

This may be one of the few moments in which he reveals the glory of his humanity in this cold and cruel world of immortality.

This worship is not only to pay homage to the Taoist friends of the same clan in the past, but also to strengthen one's Taoist heart - this world is ruthless and regards all living beings as stupid dogs, but he, Lin Yuan, must keep his bottom line.

The prerequisite for holding on to the bottom line is to survive and outlive everyone else.

After gathering the withered bones, Lin Yuan turned and walked towards the stone platform in the center of the secret room.

There were several books and bottles scattered on the stone platform.

Lin Yuan's eyes were directly locked on one of the notebooks, which was tanned with black monster skin.

"Summary of the experience of seizing the body".

This is the brainchild of Patriarch Lin who has gone through several seizures over the past hundred years, including the original owner Lin Xuanhe who took over a hundred years ago.

It not only records in detail how to calculate the soul compatibility and how to arrange the body seizing array, but also the precious records that the ancestors exchanged with countless blood——

"How to deal with the sequelae after swallowing the soul."

Lin Yuan opened it casually, and found scrawled and crazy writing on the pages of yellowed paper:

"...Anyone who seizes the body or forcibly absorbs the soul of another person can forcibly refine it with secret techniques, but there will still be fragments of the resentment of the alien soul in the sea of consciousness. These fragments are like gangrene attached to the bone. They do not show up on ordinary days, but only when the foundation is broken and the disaster is approaching.If the inner demon of the head breaks out violently during the tribulation, it can easily lead to failure and death... To get rid of this problem, you need to use the secret medicine soul-nourishing soup to cleanse the sea of consciousness for three years, or when it breaks through, it can be forcibly killed with the Yang Qi..."

Seeing this, Lin Yuan's eyes suddenly lit up.

This notebook was originally a reference manual that the ancestor planned to use for his post-operative recovery after successfully seizing Lin Yuan's body.

But now that the world is reincarnated, the ancestor never imagined that this notebook would become Lin Yuan's next reference guide for foundation building.
